Changing-Rooms.name: Changing-Rooms
Changing-Rooms.description:
Changing-Rooms:
Changing rooms magically appear, rooms move.

Menswear-Sanctuary.name: Menswear-Sanctuary
Menswear-Sanctuary.description:
Menswear-Sanctuary:
Calm music. Wide open space.
One other man stands staring at a wall, muttering:
“Someday… they’ll finish the self-checkout.”

Lingerie-Labyrinth.name: Lingerie-Labyrinth
Lingerie-Labyrinth.description:
Lingerie-Labyrinth:
Bras hang from every direction,
judging you silently.
You are certain everyone thinks you’re here for a weird reason —
including you.

Womenswear.name: Womenswear
Womenswear.description:
Womenswear:
Clothes racks rearrange themselves at will blocking exits.
Staff give contradictory directions.

Candle-Grotto.name: Candle-Grotto
Candle-Grotto.description:
Candle-Grotto:
Dim lighting. Hundreds of candles whisper scents into your soul.
 Anxiety-Breeze-candle softly whispers take me instead.

Homewear-valley.name: Homewear-valley
Homewear-valley.description:
Homewear-valley:
Throws and cushions float like clouds.

Shoe-Swamplands.name: Shoe-Swamplands
Shoe-Swamplands.description:
Shoe-Swamplands:
Odd smells. Discarded boxes everywhere.
 Too dark to see anything

Baby-Section-Maze.name: Baby-Section-Maze
Baby-Section-Maze.description:
Baby-Section-Maze:
Strollers block every path.
Tiny shoes everywhere.

Exits.name: Exits
Exits.description:
Exits:
If ANY item still has a security tag, alarms blare for 9 minutes.
NPCs stare.
Staff sigh.

Storeroom.name: Storeroom
Storeroom.description:
Store-Room:
Stacks of forgotten stock line the walls.
Boxes wobble, labels lie, and the air smells faintly of panic.
